scope: Custom — Thursday and Friday games only
historical_cutoff: Completion of the final scheduled Week 11 game; date boundary 2026-11-24T00:00:00 America/Toronto (exclusive)

sportsbook_policy.fallback: DraftKings where FanDuel unavailable; explicit authorization for this Week 12 Thursday-Friday run

methodology_overrides.p15_sample: Same 10 most recent qualifying completed regular-season games used for L10

qualification_rule: Market HR >= 6/10 OR at least one fixed ladder threshold >= 8/10
main_market_line_rule: For each player/market, select the available DraftKings line whose over price is numerically closest to -110; preserve its exact line and price. No price-distance cutoff is imposed.
